ddl.where: "due_at" is not null and "completed_at" is null
ddl.name: media_contact_interactions_open_idx

ddl.value:
("parent_id" is null and "level" = 'GOVERNORATE')
          or ("parent_id" is not null and "level" <> 'GOVERNORATE')
ddl.name: areas_root_is_governorate

ddl.value:
"starts_at" is null or "ends_at" is null
          or "ends_at" >= "starts_at"
ddl.name: initiatives_date_order

ddl.value: "email" is not null or "phone" is not null
ddl.name: partner_contacts_reachable

ddl.value:
("status" = 'ACTIVE' and "ended_at" is null)
          or ("status" = 'ENDED' and "ended_at" is not null)
ddl.name: partner_memberships_ended_consistency

ddl.value:
"status" not in ('APPROVED', 'PAUSED')
          or ("approved_at" is not null and "approved_by_id" is not null)
ddl.name: partner_partnerships_approval_consistency

ddl.value:
("type" = 'EVENT' and "initiative_id" is not null)
          or ("type" <> 'EVENT' and "initiative_id" is null)
ddl.name: partner_partnerships_event_needs_initiative

ddl.value:
"stage" <> 'ACTIVE'
          or ("activated_at" is not null and "approved_by_id" is not null)
ddl.name: partners_activation_consistency

ddl.value: "completed_at" is null or "due_at" is not null
ddl.name: media_contact_interactions_completion_needs_due

ddl.value:
"email" is not null
          or "phone" is not null
          or "profile_url" is not null
ddl.name: media_contacts_reachable

ddl.value:
("kind" = 'STAFF'
             and "office_id" is not null
             and "partner_id" is null)
          or ("kind" = 'PARTNER'
             and "partner_id" is not null
             and "office_id" is null)
ddl.name: invitations_target_matches_kind

ddl.value:
("status" <> 'ACCEPTED')
          or ("accepted_at" is not null and "accepted_user_id" is not null)
ddl.name: invitations_accepted_consistency

ddl.value:
("status" = 'ACTIVE' and "ended_at" is null)
          or ("status" = 'ENDED' and "ended_at" is not null)
ddl.name: memberships_ended_consistency

ddl.value:
("condition_field_key" is null and "condition_op" is null and "condition_value" is null)
          or ("condition_field_key" is not null and "condition_op" = 'notEmpty' and "condition_value" is null)
          or ("condition_field_key" is not null and "condition_op" in ('eq', 'in') and "condition_value" is not null)
ddl.name: form_fields_condition_consistency

ddl.value:
("type" in ('SINGLE_SELECT', 'MULTI_SELECT') and jsonb_array_length("options") > 0)
          or ("type" not in ('SINGLE_SELECT', 'MULTI_SELECT') and jsonb_array_length("options") = 0)
ddl.name: form_fields_options_consistency

ddl.value:
("type" = 'MULTI_SELECT'
             and coalesce("min_selections", 1) >= 1
             and coalesce("max_selections", 1) >= coalesce("min_selections", 1))
          or ("type" <> 'MULTI_SELECT'
             and "min_selections" is null
             and "max_selections" is null)
ddl.name: form_fields_selection_limits

ddl.value:
("type" in ('TEXT', 'LONG_TEXT') and coalesce("max_length", 1) >= 1)
          or ("type" not in ('TEXT', 'LONG_TEXT') and "max_length" is null)
ddl.name: form_fields_max_length_scope

ddl.value:
"contact_role" is null
          or ("contact_role" = 'NAME' and "type" = 'TEXT')
          or ("contact_role" = 'EMAIL' and "type" = 'EMAIL')
          or ("contact_role" = 'PHONE' and "type" = 'PHONE')
ddl.name: form_fields_contact_role_type

ddl.value:
("status" = 'DRAFT' and "published_at" is null)
          or ("status" in ('PUBLISHED', 'ARCHIVED') and "published_at" is not null)
ddl.name: form_versions_published_consistency
